name: Connected Minimal-Non-Ample Classes Are Special OM Tope Graphs
scope: Finite simple oriented matroids and their tope graphs.
statement: Every connected conditioning-minimal non-ample class is a non-free simple uniform-oriented-matroid tope graph, while not every oriented-matroid tope graph is of this form.
proof: The classification supplies the inclusion. The four-cycle is the tope graph of the free rank-two oriented matroid and is ample, so it is outside the minimal non-ample subclass.
